evidence: Structural characterizations of the nanoporous gold–alumina core–shell film were carried out using a TECNAI G 2 F30 transmission electron microscope. Energy dispersive x-ray (EDX) analysis in the scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) mode was used to determine the elemental distribution across the gold–alumina interfaces. Ultraviolet–visible (UV –vis) spectra of the nanoporous gold–alumina core–shell films were measured by a Perkin-Elmer Lambda 750 spectrophotometer in the 400–800 nm spectral range. Fourier transfer image obtained from region C marked in (b), corresponding to gold crystal. Fourier transfer image obtained from region D marked in (b), corresponding to amorphous alumina.
